coverage.notes: Mechanical abbreviation rules (DottedAbbreviations) are auto_fix. List mapping and first-use are comments. Others report_only.
Curated American-spelling review and nonpossessive eponym rules are report_only. Broad British-to-American replacement remains deferred_scope.
Core clinical terminology, inclusive language, participant terminology, dates, and selected quantitative conventions are operationalized as comments or report_only.
Labels followed by numerals, generic references, and heading case are report_only because they require context.
Multiple punctuation spaces and dash mechanics are auto_fix. Forward slash is report_only.
List introduction and list item capitalization are implemented as comments.
Age expressions, prose ranges, confidence intervals, p values, and ratio formats are report_only.
Nonbreaking spaces for units and math operator spacing are auto_fix.
Table headings and zero values are comments. Figure visual review is manual/disabled.
Scientific species, Latin expressions, and radiolabel formatting are comments via Word formatting inspection.
Raw external URLs, active hyperlinks, and citation placement are report_only.
Broader appendix-document structure is deferred_scope or report_only.
Protected-term policy and first use without expansion are comments.
Core preferred wording and trial naming are comments; lean-writing checks are report_only.
Comprise usage and selected terminology checks are report_only.
